name: Palred Technologies Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1999, Palred Technologies 
Ltd does trading of mobiles, electronic 
 products, fashion accessories and 
provides related services[1]
keyPoints:
Group Companies:[1]
Company has 3 subsidiaries viz.
a) Palred Electronics Pvt Ltd:
The Group’s main operating company, 
Palred Electronics Private Limited owns 
 consumer electronics brand, pTron. It 
offers mobile & digital lifestyle products.
b) Palred Technology Services Private Limited:
PTS offers products through its brand Xmate that is exclusively available on Amazon. Xmate sells products like Bluetooth headsets, Bluetooth speakers, wired headsets, chargers and cables, Computer Accessories, Cameras, Camera Accessories, etc. 
The brand faced many challenges since FY21 because of high advertisement costs and competition from other big brands. It was not able to achieve the desired growth and continues to make losses. Hence, company has decided to exit the Xmate brand business
c) Palred Retail Private Limited:
PRP owns e-commerce website, ptron.in and www.LatestOne.com that specialize in selling 
of tech and mobile accessories such as Blue 
tooth speakers and headsets, cables, power banks, headsets, smart watches, fashion accessories, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.15 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -7.09% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -4.74%
